title: git_head_sha reads a form it does not know as short, silently
body:
Found by the critic-shell pass on ST0011/03's is_commit_sha delta (dc, 2026-10-31). git_head_sha [root] [form] (lib/helpers:3405) takes short or full, and its case arm reads any other word as short: `git_head_sha . ful` answers the short sha with no complaint. is_commit_sha, which cites git_head_sha as the precedent for a form parameter (issue 0014), now stops on a form it does not know, so the two readers disagree about what a bad form means. Fix: git_head_sha's catch-all arm dies naming the form and the two it knows, as is_commit_sha does; one arm in helpers.bats runs the bad form in a shell of its own and reads the stop, red at the base where the call answers. Small; lands with any helpers unit after run 1, or on its own.

## Resolution

Fixed at 941e4400643c3c0e15d6f211ae9961cdbbdb7c36, landed on main by devbin-vc's land-stack.sh as one unit of group B's four (0298, 0299, 0311, 0305), unpushed until the 0.1.20 cut. git_head_sha now has short as an arm of its own, and any other form stops the call, naming itself and the two forms it knows, as is_commit_sha's form does. helpers.bats runs a misspelt form in a shell of its own and reads the stop. It was proved in group B's run on pplr-vc's desk, with each driver's kit read by devbin-vc first. In slot 01M6KY03231VVJCH6JMSK3J20X at df972df8, every unit's arms were red in its own red clone (its parent with its tests on top) and green at the tip under BSD and GNU, with every file that reaches the changed code, help and the tree scans. One arm, 0311's, trapped INT, which a backgrounded GNU leg starts with ignored. Once that arm was fixed, the targeted rerun in slot 01M6KZPRCRBPAY42KCVWWSKHF9 at b4e2a066 exited rc 0. critic-shell reviewed the stack once and every finding was settled.
